_diagnostics.note: Folding assembled from the analytical per-block models (U4 widths), costed with the MILP's own layer_cost_pe_simd / extra_node_options. Not an ILP solve. latency_ms = cycles from the first input pixel to the first output pixel (sum over blocks of each block model's first-in -> first-out latency / clock); total_cycles / sum_of_node_cycles_ms is the MILP's work-per-frame measure (every node's cycles summed), kept for the MILP schema, NOT a latency.

branch_imbalance.note: max(branch cycle sum)/min(branch cycle sum) per simple 2-branch diamond, fork to join. Diagnostic only -- see this function's own docstring for scope/limits.

chain_rate_imbalance.note: max(rate[D] over every descendant D of L) / rate[L], per node L with a real descendant. Diagnostic only -- see this function's own docstring for scope/limits.

fifo_sizing.method: every inter-block FIFO fixed at depth 2
